latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate and share video links from uploaded files without traditional hosting.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; receive a shareable 1080p MP4 link.
- Easy onboarding: automatically connects and handles free token setup with 100 credits.
- Built-in flows for uploading, checking credits/balance, tracking state, and exporting videos.
- All rendering and processing handled securely on remote GPU servers.
- Clear error handling and support for batch and iterative workflows.
- Designed for marketers who need fast, reliable video sharing without YouTube or paid hosting.
